name: cubepilot-for-homee
description: CubePilot for homee: homee fernsteuern und Homeegramme per KI bearbeiten: Backend, MCP-Server und Angular-Frontend

scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run configure
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm start -w backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/homee-client && tsc -p backend && tsc -p mcp && tsc -p remote
